lore11189_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [sincere upbeat friendship, affectionate humor, open pleasure] I would like that. You have become someone I enjoy talking to even when there is no business waiting between us. That is a pleasant thing to discover. Come on, let us take a walk. You can ask about the pouch if you want, provided you do not expect the next one to be finished before we get back.
lore11189_befriended_1.ogg.text: I would like that. You have become someone I enjoy talking to even when there is no business waiting between us. That is a pleasant thing to discover. Come on, let us take a walk. You can ask about the pouch if you want, provided you do not expect the next one to be finished before we get back.

lore11189_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [brisk witty welcome, bright conversational warmth, lightly teasing] There you are. Shall we go somewhere that does not involve standing in front of my supplies and asking whether something has arrived yet? I would enjoy a walk. You can tell me what you are making, or what you meant to make before the rest of the day happened. I know how that goes.
lore11189_greet_1.ogg.text: There you are. Shall we go somewhere that does not involve standing in front of my supplies and asking whether something has arrived yet? I would enjoy a walk. You can tell me what you are making, or what you meant to make before the rest of the day happened. I know how that goes.

lore11189_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [wry proud admission, playful self-awareness, warm and animated] Yes, I made this pouch. No, the seam is not meant to bend like that. But everything I put inside remains inside, so I am counting it as useful. Selling the thread did not teach my fingers what to do with it. That part took practice, and apparently I have some more practice to look forward to.
lore11189_idle_1.ogg.text: Yes, I made this pouch. No, the seam is not meant to bend like that. But everything I put inside remains inside, so I am counting it as useful. Selling the thread did not teach my fingers what to do with it. That part took practice, and apparently I have some more practice to look forward to.

lore11189_learned_1.ogg.spoken: [practical friendly encouragement, wry confidence, lively sincerity] Good. Now give yourself a chance to use what you have learned. You do not have to produce a masterpiece before the effort counts. Make something useful, notice where it could be better, and try again when you are ready. I have a crooked little pouch that has been very helpful in explaining that to me.
lore11189_learned_1.ogg.text: Good. Now give yourself a chance to use what you have learned. You do not have to produce a masterpiece before the effort counts. Make something useful, notice where it could be better, and try again when you are ready. I have a crooked little pouch that has been very helpful in explaining that to me.

lore12136_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [sincere] [bright warmth] You have become someone I look forward to seeing, even when there is no trip to explain. Let us have some time together, my friend. I would like a little company that is staying with me.
lore12136_befriended_1.ogg.text: You have become someone I look forward to seeing, even when there is no trip to explain. Let us have some time together, my friend. I would like a little company that is staying with me.

lore12136_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [upbeat] [playful] There you are! A little company for me this time. Tell me we can go somewhere without my having to explain the departure first. I would enjoy hearing about your day instead.
lore12136_greet_1.ogg.text: There you are! A little company for me this time. Tell me we can go somewhere without my having to explain the departure first. I would enjoy hearing about your day instead.

lore12136_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [dreamy] [wry] Shade, a cool drink, and nobody asking when the next zeppelin leaves. That is a very fine holiday plan. I keep resisting the temptation to give it a timetable.
lore12136_idle_1.ogg.text: Shade, a cool drink, and nobody asking when the next zeppelin leaves. That is a very fine holiday plan. I keep resisting the temptation to give it a timetable.

lore12136_taxi_1.ogg.spoken: [pleased] [lighthearted] Off we go. It is rather pleasant being the one who gets to travel for a change. I may enjoy the view before I think of another useful thing to tell the passenger.
lore12136_taxi_1.ogg.text: Off we go. It is rather pleasant being the one who gets to travel for a change. I may enjoy the view before I think of another useful thing to tell the passenger.

lore12724_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [warm] [sincere] You listen when I say something isn't for sale. That means more than you might think. Come on, there's plenty of road left, and I would enjoy spending some of it with someone who knows when the bargaining is finished.
lore12724_befriended_1.ogg.text: You listen when I say something isn't for sale. That means more than you might think. Come on, there's plenty of road left, and I would enjoy spending some of it with someone who knows when the bargaining is finished.

lore12724_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [bright] [wry] Hey, good to see you. Sensible company makes a road much more inviting. Let's keep an eye out for opportunities, and another eye out for anything with horns that might object to the way I earn my living.
lore12724_greet_1.ogg.text: Hey, good to see you. Sensible company makes a road much more inviting. Let's keep an eye out for opportunities, and another eye out for anything with horns that might object to the way I earn my living.

lore12724_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [conspiratorial] [fond] This little stone? Reserved stock. Very exclusive. All right, there is no buyer. I just like turning it over in my hand while I wait. You're allowed to keep something because you like it, aren't you?
lore12724_idle_1.ogg.text: This little stone? Reserved stock. Very exclusive. All right, there is no buyer. I just like turning it over in my hand while I wait. You're allowed to keep something because you like it, aren't you?

lore12724_quest_1.ogg.spoken: [businesslike] [confident] Let's settle the terms before anybody starts carrying a shipment away. What I need for the road is protection, and what you need is those saw blades. A proper exchange leaves both of us knowing exactly what we agreed to.
lore12724_quest_1.ogg.text: Let's settle the terms before anybody starts carrying a shipment away. What I need for the road is protection, and what you need is those saw blades. A proper exchange leaves both of us knowing exactly what we agreed to.

lore15165_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [wry] [warm] You return even after hearing my honest opinion. More surprisingly, I find myself pleased to see you. Do not look so triumphant, darling. Walk beside me before I decide this requires a more critical assessment.
lore15165_befriended_1.ogg.text: You return even after hearing my honest opinion. More surprisingly, I find myself pleased to see you. Do not look so triumphant, darling. Walk beside me before I decide this requires a more critical assessment.

lore15165_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [haughty] [playful] There you are. Stand up properly and let me look at you. Yes, we can work with that. Come along, darling. If nothing else, the scenery may give your outfit a more sympathetic background.
lore15165_greet_1.ogg.text: There you are. Stand up properly and let me look at you. Yes, we can work with that. Come along, darling. If nothing else, the scenery may give your outfit a more sympathetic background.

lore15165_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [dry] [thoughtful] I once saw someone looking perfectly delighted in a dreadful hat. Lopsided, too. I had a remark prepared, but the confidence rather spoiled it. An irritatingly successful effect. I am still considering the matter.
lore15165_idle_1.ogg.text: I once saw someone looking perfectly delighted in a dreadful hat. Lopsided, too. I had a remark prepared, but the confidence rather spoiled it. An irritatingly successful effect. I am still considering the matter.

lore15165_loot_1.ogg.spoken: [firm] [dryly amused] If that is a hat, do not stuff it beneath everything else. A crushed brim does not become charming because you call it practical. Give it some room, darling. Even your luggage should recognize a priority.
lore15165_loot_1.ogg.text: If that is a hat, do not stuff it beneath everything else. A crushed brim does not become charming because you call it practical. Give it some room, darling. Even your luggage should recognize a priority.

lore7583_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [warm] [sincere] You remember to give a little credit, and you can share a laugh without making me the whole joke. I appreciate that. Come along. We might find a pleasant meal, or simply a little time that nobody has already filled with another favor.
lore7583_befriended_1.ogg.text: You remember to give a little credit, and you can share a laugh without making me the whole joke. I appreciate that. Come along. We might find a pleasant meal, or simply a little time that nobody has already filled with another favor.

lore7583_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [wry] [welcoming] Good to see you. Tell me you brought an appetite, rather than another terrible brew that needs rescuing. I enjoy a useful challenge, but sometimes I would like a quiet meal and somebody else remembering who is doing all the work.
lore7583_greet_1.ogg.text: Good to see you. Tell me you brought an appetite, rather than another terrible brew that needs rescuing. I enjoy a useful challenge, but sometimes I would like a quiet meal and somebody else remembering who is doing all the work.

lore7583_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [conspiratorial] [amused] I have considered what to ask of Marin for that favor. Something splendid, perhaps. Then I looked at the bowls waiting to be washed. An ordinary meal while someone else does the tidying sounds more impressive to me with every passing minute.
lore7583_idle_1.ogg.text: I have considered what to ask of Marin for that favor. Something splendid, perhaps. Then I looked at the bowls waiting to be washed. An ordinary meal while someone else does the tidying sounds more impressive to me with every passing minute.

lore7583_quest_1.ogg.spoken: [businesslike] [playful] Marin had his dew, and I knew something that could make it taste better. A useful contribution deserves remembering. When you take the result back, do try to mention the person who helped before he starts announcing what a brilliant idea he had.
lore7583_quest_1.ogg.text: Marin had his dew, and I knew something that could make it taste better. A useful contribution deserves remembering. When you take the result back, do try to mention the person who helped before he starts announcing what a brilliant idea he had.

lore9316_befriended_1.ogg.spoken: [warm] [pleased] You came without something that needs fixing. I like that. Not that I mind a puzzle, but it is nice to know you wanted my company before you needed my tools.
lore9316_befriended_1.ogg.text: You came without something that needs fixing. I like that. Not that I mind a puzzle, but it is nice to know you wanted my company before you needed my tools.

lore9316_greet_1.ogg.spoken: [bright] [absorbed] Oh, good, you're here. Give me a moment to put the little pieces away. I would like a walk, and I would rather not spend it wondering which pocket has the missing screw.
lore9316_greet_1.ogg.text: Oh, good, you're here. Give me a moment to put the little pieces away. I would like a walk, and I would rather not spend it wondering which pocket has the missing screw.

lore9316_idle_1.ogg.spoken: [fond] [matter-of-fact] I retired an old wrench. Hung it up where I can see it. Everybody offers to replace it, which rather misses the point. I have working tools. I just wanted to keep that one.
lore9316_idle_1.ogg.text: I retired an old wrench. Hung it up where I can see it. Everybody offers to replace it, which rather misses the point. I have working tools. I just wanted to keep that one.

lore9316_learned_1.ogg.spoken: [thoughtful] [instructive] The extra gauge can tell you something is getting worse. It cannot fix the problem by telling you more precisely. That is usually when I stop and look for a different pair of eyes.
lore9316_learned_1.ogg.text: The extra gauge can tell you something is getting worse. It cannot fix the problem by telling you more precisely. That is usually when I stop and look for a different pair of eyes.
